summary_en: This Phase 1 study is testing zanubrutinib added to Pola-R-CHP and high-dose methotrexate in adults with secondary central nervous system lymphoma. Zanubrutinib is taken by mouth as capsules, starting at 160 mg twice a day or 320 mg once a day at the beginning of Cycle 2 of Pola-R-CHP, and participants are in the study for up to 2 years. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it lists the study as Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa zanubrutinib añadido a Pola-R-CHP y metotrexato en dosis altas en adultos con linfoma secundario del sistema nervioso central. El zanubrutinib se toma por vía oral en cápsulas, comenzando con 160 mg dos veces al día o 320 mg una vez al día al inicio del Ciclo 2 de Pola-R-CHP, y los participantes permanecen en el estudio hasta 2 años. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; figura como estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Large B-cell lymphoma confirmed by histology under WHO classification.
Lymphoma involving both systemic sites and the central nervous system at presentation.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less, except when caused by lymphoma.
not_for: Primary CNS lymphoma without evidence of systemic lymphoma.
Prior systemic lymphoma therapy, including anthracycline-based regimens, with exceptions listed in the record.
Uncontrolled or clinically significant heart disease, including recent heart attack or QTcF above 450 msec.
Active HIV or hepatitis B or C infection, with exceptions listed in the record.
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or current treatment with strong CYP3A inducers.
